description: This file implements the ROCm C++ Scheduling class for PyTorch's code generation, specifically managing kernel code generation, fusion decisions, and template handling for ROCm C++ kernels within the inductor compiler.

classes.name: ROCmCPPScheduling
classes.description: Partial implementation of a scheduler for ROCm C++ kernels, handling fusion, kernel code generation, and template rendering for ROCm-specific kernels.

methods.name: group_fn(self, sizes)
methods.description: Creates a simplified tuple of product of sizes for scheduling purposes.

methods.name: bool is_rocm_cpp_template(node: BaseSchedulerNode)
methods.description: Checks if a node is a ROCmTemplateBuffer wrapped in a SchedulerNode, indicating a ROCm C++ template.

methods.name: bool can_fuse_vertical( self, node1: BaseSchedulerNode, node2: BaseSchedulerNode )
methods.description: Indicates whether two nodes can be vertically fused; currently always returns False.

methods.name: str define_kernel(self, src_code: str, node_schedule)
methods.description: Defines a kernel, generating kernel name and code, possibly with fusion and metadata, and registers it.

methods.name: codegen_template( self, template_node: BaseSchedulerNode, epilogue_nodes: Sequence[BaseSchedulerNode], prologue_nodes: Sequence[BaseSchedulerNode], )
methods.description: Generates ROCm C++ kernel code for a template node, including handling fused epilogue and prologue nodes, code rendering, and kernel invocation.

ctags.name: codegen_template
ctags.signature: ( self, template_node: BaseSchedulerNode, epilogue_nodes: Sequence[BaseSchedulerNode], prologue_nodes: Sequence[BaseSchedulerNode], )

ctags.name: define_kernel
ctags.pattern: /^    def define_kernel(self, src_code: str, node_schedule) -> str:$/
